answer: Sybil resistance is enforced by a funding-graph kernel, not by counting names. An applicant posts a marble of 2.5 times last epoch's median payout, then is scored with a radial-basis kernel over shared UTXOs, co-signers, and autonomous-system hops. Similarity above a 0.15 threshold slashes that marble and folds the application into the existing seat. The live epoch beacon reseeds the feature weights, preventing a farm from pre-tuning a disguise for the next intake. Residual marble unlocks only after two later beacons, which makes each extra clone a locked-capital loss instead of another vote.
